purpose: Teach: 別段/係り/入れ替わり/直轄/年俸/引上げ/支配人/バランスシート

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、お客様には別段のサービスを用意しろ
lines.en: Prepare a dedicated service tier for our clients.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative. Measured cadence. No inflection—each phrase lands with equal weight. The tone of someone accustomed to being understood without elaboration.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。窓口の係りを新しく配置しました
lines.en: Yes. I've assigned a new attendant to the front desk.
lines.style: Steady, attentive. Brief pause after 'Yes'—acknowledging the instruction before moving to completion. Factual delivery, no embellishment. Eyes engaged.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、シフト入れ替わり時の引き継ぎを確実にしろ
lines.en: Make sure the handover process during shift changes is airtight.
lines.style: Direct, no-nonsense. Slight emphasis on 'airtight'—the non-negotiable element. Pause between clauses. The voice of someone who has seen what happens when systems slip.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。本社直轄の新部署を作りました
lines.en: Yes. I've established a new department under direct headquarters oversight.
lines.style: Composed, matter-of-fact. Speaks at a deliberate pace. The 'yes' comes quickly—then a beat before the substantive news. Confidence without pride.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 幹部の年俸制度を見直せ
lines.style: Measured, businesslike. The words are important; they receive their weight. No softening. Delivered as a directive that expects action, not debate.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。給与の引上げを社員に通知しました
lines.en: Yes. I've notified the staff of the salary adjustments.
lines.style: Clear and professional. The 'yes' is brief—focused on delivering the substantive information. Even pacing. Slightly warmer than previous updates: this news will land well.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、店舗の支配人を増員しろ
lines.en: Increase the number of store managers across the company.
lines.style: Firm, unambiguous. Slight emphasis on 'increase'—the action verb. Minimal words, maximum clarity. The tone of institutional resolve.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。決算のバランスシートを準備しました
lines.en: Yes. I've prepared the balance sheet for review.
lines.style: Prompt, efficient. The closing note—'yes' arrives fast, followed by the final piece of information. A small breath before 'review'—marking the end of the sequence. Calm and complete.
